_about: Census-people basis store for the 1993 federal election (the 1991-census side of the people-interp lane for that frame — derive-booth-demo-90s.py's six-store output; see its header). The people-smallest-area is a 1991-census collection district: a booth's demo block is that CD's census counts pinned to the venue's approximate location from data/booth-locations-history.json (the map's own published history-venue store; pre-2001 elections have no AEC coordinate roll), a division's the exact census sum over the CDs whole-allocated to the era's division set (seifa-src/cd-1991-ced-1993set.json — the Parliamentary Handbook era polygons, the map's published era set). Venue-to-CD mapping is point-in-poly where the venue point sits inside a district, and the era-nearest CD along the era's own survey-draft linework within 1,500 m (counts.boothsGeoNearest, those venues' median rescue distance counts.geoNearestDistP50, p95 counts.geoNearestDistP95) where no district contains it — the era boundaries' drafting vintage puts most venue points within a couple of hundred metres of the printed line. The '90s lane reads the GCP-era six lanes plus the follow-on people cohorts on the census's own AURIN Basic Community Profile (extract-bcp-aurin-tally.py): persons, ages, home-language share, birthplace, education level, blue-collar occupation, birthplace-country menu (cob, the measured census side's own menu era — 1991 ), religion (rel), housing tenure (ten), the Indigenous status and one-parent lanes. The era's print holes read null at every level rather than a cross-era substitute: the 1991 BCP prints no Hindu row and no India/Sri Lanka birthplace, the 1996 BCP's dwelling tenure table carries no landlord arm (rentPub), and the year-of-schooling GP lane has no era edition before the 2006 census by print history, so y12less stays absent on the '90s-era frames. Ancestry has no print before the 2001 census's own and no era-mate on the '90s sides at all, so ancKeys/car lanes stay null. The census's ABS-filed balance classes named offshoreClass in the allocation file are dropped here entirely by ABS's own filing. The demoI blocks interpolate the people figures between the 1991 and 1996 censuses to election day (day-share 0.320197 of the intercensal span — the season's CENSUS_NIGHT/ELECTION_DAY day counts themselves (this year's election predates every SEIFA cohort's cover, so there is no SEIFA lane to cross-read)): each demoI lane blends the two census sides' shares, a lane missing on either side falling back to the measured block for that lane; incMed and the incomeCutsI dollar figures come from the 1991 census side alone, never a mixed-currency blend. The far side of the blend is data/booth-demo-1993-c1.json.
deliveryBasis: venue PIP of the history-location-store coordinates over the 1991-census CD polygons; exact CD sum per division (seifa-src/cd-1991-ced-1993set.json)
